summary: Two independent R3 reviews confirm value-only poison, dual AP005 and replay grain, but v33 still cannot append markers in a 0550 active directory, lacks fixed attempt roots and persistent ArtifactRef locators/hash domains, leaves authority-registration equality and plan/purpose constraints open, under-specifies prepared recovery and oversized orphan handling, and does not close versioned delist observations or all lifecycle wrappers, issuer digest projections and typed poison domains.

limitations: Both reviewers were read-only and did not edit design, product, test, gate or ledger files.
Neither reviewer invoked quality_ledger or ran replay, training, real data, PIT certification, budget consumption or final-OOS access.
